About the Sunday Ride from Monocacy Middle School (Frederick Pedalers) group ride

A no-cue-sheet ride that wanders the west side of Route 15, a slightly different way each week. The club calls itself friendly and it is club policy not to drop a rider. Start time shifts with the season; check the ride calendar.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
